title: node_stuck_by_class pin is single-scenario: mixed-class piles, counts-size guard, and the waiting_ticks==0 exclusion are never exercised
evidence:
testing.expectf(t, total == 2 && counts[1] == 2,
		"host stuck-by-class: want total 2, streaming 2; got total %d counts %v", total, counts)
	testing.expectf(t, counts[0] == 0,
		"host must have zero stuck email (email flows), got %d", counts[0])

	// a dead slot reads zero (defensive bounds)
	dead_total := node_stuck_by_class(&s.flow, &s.topology, cat, u32(len(s.topology.node_alive)), counts[:])
detail: Pin is non-vacuous (I ran it: 184/184 core tests pass) but only covers one stuck class + dead slot. Mixed-class piles (the card line's " - " join and "+N more" cap), the p.class < len(counts) guard, and the waiting_ticks==0 skip stay unpinned.
recommended_fix: Extend the pin to a two-class stuck pile at one node (assert per-class counts + total) and a counts slice shorter than a class id; the card-line render stays scratch-verified.

title: Pool gauge + drop markers: zero durable automated coverage; the programmatic pixel-scan is only a PR-body claim with no committed artifact; the green harness is a negative proof only
evidence:
PR body: "Scratch pixel-scan (rlsw shadow + LoadImageFromScreen): pool bar fill, SHEDDING tag, and drop-marker positions verified programmatically; QoS depth row layout measured against the rendered label"
Spec: "Manual checks (if no CLI): Scratch capture (rlsw shadow + LoadImageFromScreen, the 5.3 addendum recipe): drive draw_world + draw_pool_gauge + draw_drop_markers on a surge fixture; PIL-scan the pool-bar rect for the expected fill color + a marker's presence near a known bundle midpoint"
harness/goldens.odin:62-69: "rnd.draw_world(&rc.view, topo, bundles, flow, crisis, tick, {})
	rnd.draw_forecast_panel(&rc.view, crisis, rc.view.catalogs, era, preview)
	rnd.draw_health_meter(&rc.view, health, rc.view.catalogs, health_on)
	...
	rnd.draw_crisis_banner(&rc.view, crisis, rc.view.catalogs, era, banner_y)"
detail: No test exercises draw_pool_gauge or draw_drop_markers (no app tests exist; capture_frame never calls them, so the 29/29 green run I reproduced cannot catch a broken gauge/marker). NO_BUNDLE skip, dead-bundle skip, (lo,hi) identity guard, fade, and prune edge cases are all by-construction only.
recommended_fix: Commit the rlsw scratch-capture as a runnable tool (assert fill color, SHEDDING tag, marker anchor/fade pixels) wired into tools/lint or a smoke target so the claimed scan is reproducible.

title: Why-dropped split is absent for a class whose drops are exclusively 2.3 severed culls — drop_reasons row never grows, so 'every loss keeps a named cause' fails
detail: Rows grow only from sites; the cull counts sla_count_drop with no site. A class that only lost via severance (e.g. a demolished junction culls a stranded single-class pile) has dropped>0, no row, no split — spec AC 'the line carries pool N / queue M' fails and the split never sums.
recommended_fix: Drop the row-existence guard: show the split whenever acc.dropped > 0 (grow rows from the SLA roster, or render 'severed N' when pool+queue==0), and pin the pure arithmetic as a core test.

title: QoS queue-depth row, card cause line, and feed_drop_sites ring: happy-path-only app wiring with no integration/E2E coverage (unit-only mix)
detail: The NO_BUNDLE/absent-pipe branches, qos_queue_depth_y editing offsets, ring prune cutoff, and the card's third line have no automated test at any level; no harness demo reaches them by design. Feed arithmetic and layout are verified only by the claimed scratch scan.
recommended_fix: At minimum pin qos_queue_depth_y/panel-height arithmetic and the prune cutoff in a small app-layer test; consider a harness-invisible smoke demo rendering one frame with a surge fixture.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence: My run at the reviewed sha (tools/harness.sh run): "harness: 29 demo(s) green" (29 PASS lines, T1 state hashes + T2 pixels + replay gate). "odin test core" — "Finished 184 tests in 2.467554s. All tests were successful." Spec Verification: "tools/harness.sh run -- expected: all 29 demos green (byte-identical T1/T2; the spine proof)"
detail: P0 100%: determinism spine empirically green (29/29, byte-identical) and the new core pin passes; no P1 critical-path gaps (sim untouched). But durable automated coverage of the diff's 7 behavior changes is ~14% (only the core proc pinned); five HUD surfaces + feed rest on a claimed, non-reproducible scratch scan — below the PASS bar.
